items.title: Waive Notice
notes:
Prior to beginning the Special Council meeting this date, it was noted Council was being requested to Waive Notice to amend the start time of the meeting this date.

To approve the amended start time, 2/3 of the Whole of Council is required.

items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:41 this date, chaired by Councillor D. Chapman, Acting Mayor. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Councillor D. Chapman, Acting Mayor.

items.title: Notice All-Council Meeting / Region of Waterloo & Area Municipalities - For Information
notes: Councillor Chapman advised that the Mayor and Members of Kitchener City Council have been invited to participate in a joint meeting with the Councils of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo and all Area Municipalities within the Region of Waterloo on Friday June 21, 2024 at 2:00 p.m., further notice of the meeting will be published at www.regionofwaterloo.ca.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Pyrotechnic and Firework Authorization, DSD-2024-291
notes: Council considered Development Services Department report DSD-2024-291, entitled Pyrotechnic and Firework Authorization, dated June 12, 2024, recommending approval to execute pyrotechnic and firework permit documentation consenting to firework displays on City Property for city-initiated events. J. Dueck, Director Culture and Entertainment was in attendance to respond to questions from Council.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for June 17, 2024.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 4:47 p.m.
